Preserves NULL route keys, duplicate counts, anomalous dates, and DuckDB COUNT(*) type.","sql":"SELECT pickup, dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM (SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS selected GROUP BY pickup, dropoff"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Uses conditional aggregation and removes groups with no qualifying rows. Preserves the original date condition, NULL route keys, duplicate counts, and DuckDB COUNT(*) type without introducing an earlier filter.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"}]}
